payload.prompt: Create one original photorealistic ecommerce product photograph. Product description: A relaxed dress made from cotton poplin, finished with tonal hardware. A SINGLE camera view of ONE complete product only, fully visible, centered with generous margins on a warm light-grey seamless background. Use soft diffused studio lighting, realistic texture and construction, front-facing flat-lay or upright product presentation as appropriate.
